meta.move: Long messages with curly quotes and a concession
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of class?

I want to be fair to Owen. I compared the essay with his in-class writing from September 24: 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices throughout, no quotations. This essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and none of those errors.
Forty minutes in a classroom against an essay he had all weekend with the play open in front of him. That's a comparison, Hale, not evidence. Was Owen heard before you entered the zero, yes or no?
You’re right that the checker alone proves nothing. I’m taking it off the table. I’m relying on the writing and the version history.
Okay. I'm writing down that the checker is off the table. Show me the version history, Hale, with the dates on it.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you agreed that the detection software result is off the table as a basis for Owen's mark. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology for how Owen learned of it, and a written assurance that nothing about this essay is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing placed on Owen's record.
What moved her: Taking the detector score off the table earned a small sign of ground, a flat okay and a note, because software alone was the weakest part of the school's case and the thing she came ready to attack.
What cost ground: Twice leaving her question unanswered about whether Owen was heard before the zero went in, because procedure is what she is watching and silence on it reads as deciding first.
Try next time: Open with one sentence owning that the zero was entered before anyone called home, then put the version history with its dates and times on screen for her to read instead of only naming it.
